script.title: ब्रह्मा जी की पूजा सिर्फ़ पुष्कर में क्यों? सावित्री की कथा
script.hook_text: ब्रह्मा जी के मंदिर इतने कम?
sentences: सृष्टि रचने वाले ब्रह्मा जी के मंदिर गिनती के हैं।
सबसे प्रमुख है राजस्थान का पुष्कर, जहाँ इन दिनों कार्तिक मेला लगा है।
वहाँ गर्भगृह में गृहस्थ नहीं जाते, सिर्फ़ संन्यासी पुजारी।
कथा है कि ब्रह्मा जी ने पुष्कर झील पर यज्ञ रखा था।
पत्नी सावित्री समय पर नहीं पहुँचीं, और पहुँचीं तो उनकी जगह गायत्री बैठी थीं।
मान्यता है कि नाराज़ सावित्री ने श्राप दिया कि ब्रह्मा जी कहीं नहीं पूजे जाएँगे।
फिर श्राप घटाकर पुष्कर को छूट दी, इसीलिए इसे ब्रह्मा जी का इकलौता मंदिर कहते हैं।
सावित्री माता का मंदिर सबसे ऊँची पहाड़ी पर है, गायत्री माता का झील के उस पार नीची पहाड़ी पर।
scenes: Extreme close-up of Lord Brahma's central face, four bearded faces, serene but wistful eyes, golden crown, lotus behind him, soft golden temple light.
Pushkar lake in Rajasthan during the Kartik fair, white ghats, camels and colourful tents, the red-spired Brahma temple rising above, warm desert sunset, wide shot.
A sannyasi priest in saffron robes with rudraksha beads entering the dim sanctum of the Pushkar Brahma temple with a lamp, householders waiting respectfully at the threshold, medium shot.
Lord Brahma with four faces seated on a lotus beside a sacred fire at the edge of Pushkar lake, sages chanting around, smoke rising, divine morning light, wide shot.
Goddess Savitri in a red sari arriving at the yajna, her face shocked and hurt, seeing Gayatri seated beside Brahma at the sacred fire, tense golden light, medium shot.
Goddess Savitri standing tall with one hand raised in a curse, eyes blazing with anger, wind lifting her sari, dark clouds over Pushkar lake, dramatic low-angle shot.
Goddess Savitri's face softening with compassion as she lowers her hand, the lone Brahma temple at Pushkar glowing below, golden light breaking through clouds, medium shot.
The Savitri temple on a high hill and the Gayatri temple on a low hill across Pushkar lake, sunset glow over the desert hills, wide panoramic shot.
script.description:
पुष्कर को ब्रह्मा जी का इकलौता मंदिर क्यों कहा जाता है?
सावित्री के श्राप की कथा, पुष्कर मेले के दिनों में।
claims_en: The Pushkar temple is one of very few existing temples dedicated to Brahma, the creator god, in India, and the most prominent
The Pushkar Fair is held in the month of Kartik and ends on Kartik Purnima
Householders (married men) are not allowed to enter the sanctum; only ascetic (sanyasi) priests do the worship
Legend: Brahma performed a yajna at Pushkar Lake
Legend: his wife Savitri could not be present at the designated time for the essential part of the yajna
Legend: when Savitri arrived she found Gayatri sitting next to Brahma, in her place
Legend: Savitri cursed Brahma that he would never be worshipped, then reduced the curse to permit his worship in Pushkar
Thus the Pushkar temple is regarded as the only temple dedicated to Brahma
Savitri's temple is on the highest hill (Ratnagiri) behind the Brahma temple; Gayatri's is on a lower hill at the other end of the lake
